<thought>To locate the template that, when applied to the target molecule, yields the listed precursors, I will search the template catalog for reactions that break a trimethylsilyl (silyl ether) group and form an aliphatic hydroxyl, which matches the transformation observed in the precursor list.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["trimethylsilyl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
